messages.author: 25ce5e85187da1a3
messages.subject: Penalized complexity priors in Stan?
parts:
Dear Stan developers,

Do you consider to implement so-called "penalized complexity priors" (http://arxiv.org/pdf/1403.4630v4.pdf) to Stan in the next releases?

Thank you and best regards,

Burak Gunhan

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Penalized complexity priors in Stan?
parts:
Hi Burak,

Luckily for you, it looks like the priors are continuous, so you can use Stan to write those priors on your own in the Stan language! You would have been able to do that since v1.0.

If you think something in that paper has a name and a parameterization, I'd start by writing a log probability function in Stan and making sure it works.


Daniel

Again thank you and regards,
